name: effect/motion-blur
title: Motion Blur
title_vi: Nhoè chuyển động kiểu After Effects
desc_vi: Nhoè chuyển động kiểu After Effects: tích phân mỗi phần tử qua cửa sổ màn trập (góc, pha, số mẫu) bằng cách lấy mẫu timeline.
params_vi: duration: độ dài của block (4 s) · replace: các cặp [chữ gốc, chữ mới] đổi nội dung trước khi chạy (ví dụ tiếng Việt)
notes: Run as shipped: the block's own page (assets/demo.html) in an iframe, its timeline set from the film's time. Fonts: Google / fontsource families are drawn with the kit's RFlex / RMono. Shown through the component's own demo page (a full composition). To apply the snippet to the film's own elements, ask Claude: the snippet is in assets/motion-blur.html. Source: After Effects-style motion blur — integrates each element over a shutter window (shutter angle, phase, samples per frame) by sampling the GSAP timeline at sub-frame times and averaging equal-weight additive copies of the element along its real trajectory, so translation, scale, rotation, 3D rotation and skew all drive the smear
